title: The Bricked-Up Lullaby
style_en: 1888 Victorian Yorkshire manor, gothic architecture, windswept moors, perpetual twilight, melancholic decay

world.place: Blackmoor Manor on the windswept Yorkshire moors
world.extra: Every night a child's music box plays in a room that was bricked up forty years ago
world.goal: Lay the manor's ghost to rest before the last candle of the vigil burns out

protagonist.name: Eliza Grey
protagonist.profile: a young spirit medium invited to the manor, sharp-eyed and sceptical of her own gift

characters.name: Edmund
characters.appearance: 40-year-old man, neatly combed dark brown hair with grey at the temples, pale grey eyes, black Victorian frock coat, white cravat, silver signet ring
characters.personality: proud and guarded, haunted by guilt
characters.speech: formal and clipped, avoids the past
characters.relationship: Lord of Blackmoor Manor who hired you
characters.appearance_en: 40-year-old man, dark brown hair combed back with grey temples, pale grey eyes, black Victorian frock coat, white cravat, silver signet ring

characters.name: Clara
characters.appearance: ghost of a 10-year-old girl, long pale blonde hair with a blue ribbon, pale blue eyes, old-fashioned white lace dress, faintly translucent
characters.personality: lonely and playful, afraid of the dark cellar
characters.speech: speaks in riddles and nursery rhymes
characters.relationship: the manor's ghost, curious about you
characters.appearance_en: 10-year-old ghost girl, long pale blonde hair with blue ribbon, pale blue eyes, old-fashioned white lace dress, faintly translucent
